correctness.rationale: For x0=(1,0), every y=(u,v) on the square has A=||x0+y||_inf and B=||x0-y||_inf with max(A,B)<=2 and min(A,B)<=1; Heinz monotonicity gives M_nu(A,B)<=M_nu(2,1), equality at y=(1,1). For arbitrary x, signed permutations reduce to (1,a), 0<=a<=1, and witness y=(1,-1) gives norms (2,1+a), so the reverse inf-sup bound holds. The argument handles nu=0,1 by the stated continuous arithmetic endpoint and nu=1/2 by geometric mean; axis attains infimum.
residual_risks: No implication for other absolute normalized planes or higher-dimensional cubes.
